items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: we saw J. L. Cronan's Carnival Show where they needed a band... we joined them... and that's where we played

ctx.x: I sent her back home in Durham. Well, the show broke up and after that we went to look in the paper and we saw J. L. Cronan's Carnival Show where they needed a band. So, Holt wired them -- the trombone player wired them, so we went there and we joined them in Burlington, North Carolina. And that's where we played for the -- see, this was a 42-car carnival and we played the minstrel part. And, of
course, every evening we would have to go out in the town and play to draw the crowd and (unintelligible) The man would spiel
